title: Predicted (not yet confirmed) risk has no defined place in IHR notification practice
national_evidence: CM-PSNLP-2024-2028 (Ministère de la Santé Publique / PNLP, 2024), p. 108
recommendation: Define how model-predicted cross-border risk is assessed against the IHR decision instrument before any notification or neighbour information.

title: No standard for validating and monitoring a model before and after deployment
national_evidence: CM-PSNSN-2026-2030 (Ministère de la Santé Publique, 2026), p. 30
recommendation: Require external validation, a declared validity envelope, local calibration before new-region use, and post-deployment drift monitoring.
ai_readiness: D4 Contextualization and Regional Impact; D5 Level of Integration of AI in Workflows; D10 AI & Policies

title: No requirement to publish the validity limits of models used by public bodies
national_evidence: CM-PSNLP-2024-2028 (Ministère de la Santé Publique / PNLP, 2024), p. 6–7
practice_examples: WHO-AI-ETHICS-2021 (World Health Organization, 2021), p. 42 | EU-AI-ACT-SUMMARY (European Union, 2024)
recommendation: Require a public transparency note for any model used in public-health decisions, including where it was shown not to work.
ai_readiness: D6 Human Interface; D10 AI & Policies

title: No framework for routine data sharing between health, meteorology and telecom actors
national_evidence: CM-PSNLP-2019-2023 (Ministère de la Santé Publique / PNLP, 2019), p. 29
practice_examples: AU-AI-STRATEGY-2024 (African Union, 2024), p. 31–32 | WHO-AI-ETHICS-2021 (World Health Organization, 2021), p. 104
recommendation: Adopt data-sharing agreements between health, meteorology and network operators, with a common schema for climate-health data.
ai_readiness: D3 Cross-Domain Correlation Analysis; D7 Strategy Alignment

title: No sector rule for AI tools used in public-health decision support
national_evidence: CM-PSNLP-2024-2028 (Ministère de la Santé Publique / PNLP, 2024), p. 55
practice_examples: WHO-AI-ETHICS-2021 (World Health Organization, 2021), p. 37–38 | UN-GOVERNING-AI-2024 (UN High-level Advisory Body on AI, 2024), p. 8–9 | EU-AI-ACT-SUMMARY (European Union, 2024)
recommendation: Adopt a risk-tiered rule for AI decision-support in health, with pre-deployment evaluation proportionate to impact.

title: Automated decisions and profiling in public-health targeting
national_evidence: CM-LAW-2024-017 (Présidence de la République du Cameroun, 2024), art. 44, p. 16–17
practice_examples: AU-MALABO-2014 (African Union, 2014), p. 22 | WHO-AI-ETHICS-2021 (World Health Organization, 2021), p. 34–35 | UN-GOVERNING-AI-2024 (UN High-level Advisory Body on AI, 2024), p. 33
recommendation: Clarify whether district-level targeting driven by a model is an automated decision, and what human review and explanation it requires.
ai_readiness: D8 Collaboration with AI; D10 AI & Policies

title: Conditions for transferring health data abroad for model training are unclear
national_evidence: CM-LAW-2024-017 (Présidence de la République du Cameroun, 2024), art. 32, p. 13
practice_examples: AU-MALABO-2014 (African Union, 2014), art. 10, 15, p. 22–23 | WHO-AI-ETHICS-2021 (World Health Organization, 2021), p. 56–57
recommendation: Publish implementing rules for cross-border transfers of health data used to train models, including pseudonymisation and processor obligations.
ai_readiness: D1 Data/Model Marketplace; D10 AI & Policies
